summary: Overview of the in-editor Modeling Mode: how to open it, its panels, the triangle/PolyGroup model, Accept/Cancel and undo behaviour, output types (Static Mesh, Dynamic Mesh, Volume), the modeling gizmo and hotkeys, Mesh Element Selection, tool presets, and the tool categories.
gotchas: Modeling Mode is Beta
Changes apply only on Accept; exiting the mode or Cancel discards them, and after Accept undo reverts the whole tool session
Mesh Element Selection requires exiting and re-entering Modeling Mode after enabling
Duplicate high-resolution meshes before editing to preserve the original

summary: Step-by-step tutorial building a wooden crate in Modeling Mode: Box primitive, GrpGen PolyGroups, PolyEd Inset/Extrude/Decompose/Bevel/Weld, UV Unwrap by PolyGroups, applying a material, then adding box simplified collision and Simulate Physics.
gotchas: Modeling Mode is Beta
Material set in the level Details panel applies only to that instance; set it in the Static Mesh Editor for all instances
Generated assets land in FirstPerson/Maps/_GENERATED/User in the example

summary: Explains PolyGroups (named groups of triangles that emulate quads/n-gons) in Modeling Mode, their face/edge/vertex anatomy, ways to create them (Tri Select, Merge, Paint PolyGroups, Generate PolyGroups conversion modes, PolyGroup Mode on primitives, PolyGroup Layers) and their use for editing, UV unwrapping, and multi-material assignment.
gotchas: Beta feature
Merging PolyGroups is destructive
PolyGroup Layers are per static mesh asset, not project-wide
Single-triangle PolyGroups can give unexpected results such as slanted edge loops

summary: How Modeling Mode creates and stores meshes: Static Mesh vs Dynamic Mesh vs Volume output types, the preview Dynamic Mesh used while editing, tools that can write to new or input objects, and the Modeling Mode project settings for asset generation location/mode, collision, and ray tracing.
gotchas: Dynamic Meshes are not compatible with Lumen or Nanite and are inefficient for rendering/memory
Editing a Static Mesh updates all instances; use MshDup for a separate copy
Default Mesh Object Type requires an editor restart
Assets in the Temp folder cannot be saved until moved; Enable Persistent Selections is Experimental

summary: How-to for the Merge Actors Proxy Geometry tool showing how Override Spatial Sampling Distance controls the minimum feature size captured during remeshing, and its effect on simplification.
gotchas: Larger sampling distance means less simplification; the value actually used is written to the Output Log

summary: How to enable the Proxy Geometry tool by selecting the ProxyLODMeshReduction plugin in Project Settings and opening it as the second tab of Tools > Merge Actors.
gotchas: Options stay grayed out until a Static Mesh placed in a level is selected

summary: How-to using Merge Distance and Transfer Distance Override in the Proxy Geometry tool to close gaps like doors and windows in nearly watertight distant buildings via dilation/erosion.
gotchas: Large Merge Distance can generate geometry extending beyond the original; requires iteration
Inaccessible interior geometry of watertight meshes is discarded

summary: Tip for the Proxy Geometry tool: add blocker meshes to seal openings so the tool removes interior geometry, giving fewer triangles and better texture use.
How-to adjusting Hard Edge Angle (with Normal Map disabled) in the Proxy Geometry tool to get proxy mesh normals that match the source, and the vertex-count tradeoff.
gotchas: Hard Edge Angle increases vertex count and may add UV seams

summary: Technique for cheaper dynamic shadows: disable Cast Shadows on detailed meshes and use a simplified proxy caster mesh with Render in Main Pass disabled.
gotchas: Proxy shadow caster must be aligned with the visible original

summary: Reference table of Proxy Geometry tool settings (Screen Size, Merge Distance, Hard Edge Angle, lightmap and distance-field options) and the r.ProxyLOD* console variables.
gotchas: Large geometry with small sampling distance has very high memory cost
r.ProxyLODCorrectCollapsedWalls may cause cracks

summary: How to run the Proxy Geometry tool from editor scripts via the Create Proxy Mesh Actor Blueprint node or unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.create_proxy_mesh_actor(), with a Python example merging selected actors into one proxy mesh.
gotchas: Requires Editor Scripting Utilities plugin
Inputs must be Static Mesh Actors, not Actors containing Static Mesh Components
Learn the UI version first; settings strongly affect results

summary: Basic how-to: select Static Meshes, open Tools > Merge Actors, use the Proxy Geometry tab, and generate a merged simplified Static Mesh with baked material and textures.
gotchas: Processing can take from minutes to hours
Options active only with Static Meshes selected

summary: How to combine the Proxy Geometry tool with legacy HLODs: enable Hierarchical LOD System and Simplify Mesh in World Settings LODSystem, then Generate Clusters and Generate Proxy Meshes in the Hierarchical LOD Outliner.

Tour of the Animation Sequence Editor: toolbar actions (Reimport, Apply Compression, Export, Key, Make Static Mesh, Edit In Sequencer/Control Rig), the full Animation Asset Details property list (interpolation, rate scale, retargeting source, additive anim type, root motion, compression, import settings), Skeleton Tree, Asset Editor types and Asset Browser.
gotchas: Mesh Space additive type is required for Aim Offsets
Child AnimMontages with a Parent Asset can only be changed via the Asset Mapping Table
Do Not Override Compression protects high-frequency animations from the CompressAnimations commandlet

summary: Explains Animation Sequence assets: importing from FBX with the import options and Skeleton selection, baking from Sequencer, editing with additive bone tracks and Record, sharing animations across skeletons (compatible skeletons, retargeting, IK Rig), and Bone/Curve Compression Settings assets.
gotchas: Animations with non-whole end frame values do not import correctly; fix in DCC or set the Frame Import Range
Leaving Skeleton blank on import creates a new Skeleton; bone names and hierarchy must match to reuse one
Bone Compression Settings need at least one codec in the list

summary: Hub page: introduces the collection of step-by-step animation how-to guides for the Animation Editors; the link table itself is not included in the extract.

Explains Blend Space, Blend Space 1D, Aim Offset and Aim Offset 1D assets: creating them, setting axis names/ranges, placing samples, using them via a Blend Space player in the AnimGraph, and the Asset Details properties (triangulation vs grid, smoothing, weight speed, notify trigger mode) plus Blend Graph preview and debugging.
gotchas: Leave Use Grid disabled except for special cases like Wrap Input; triangulation is more accurate
Do not combine Weight Speed/Smoothing with Smoothing Time/Smoothing Type
Thin triangles shown in red, or red-highlighted samples in grid mode, will not blend properly
Wrap Input needs similar animations at both ends of the axis to avoid popping

summary: Basic guide to exporting skeletal meshes and joints from Maya/3ds Max to FBX and importing them through the Content Browser with FBX Import Options, including choosing an existing skeleton and verifying the result.
gotchas: Import pipeline uses FBX 2020.2; other versions may be incompatible
Multiple skeletal meshes in one FBX become separate assets

summary: Describes the Morph Target Previewer panel in the animation editors, driving morph targets at runtime with the Set Morph Target node, the Selected MorphTarget Vertices debug overlay, and enabling GPU morph target computation.
keys: Use GPU for computing morph targets
gotchas: GPU morph target computation requires Shader Model 5 target platforms

summary: Reference for the Skeletal Mesh Editor: reimport options (base mesh, LODs, content), Cloth Paint, Make Static Mesh, and the Asset Details properties for LOD info, Skeletal Mesh Reduction settings, LOD streaming, Physics Asset, Post Process Anim Blueprint, import settings and ray tracing.
gotchas: Enforce Bone Boundaries can give undesirable results under extreme simplification
Cloth LOD Bias Mode affects memory and which LODs can be ray traced

summary: Reference for the Skeleton Editor: toolbar (Anim Notifies, Retarget Sources, Import Mesh), Skeleton Tree add options (Socket, Virtual Bone, blend profiles, Blend Mask), tree filter/retargeting options, Bone Manipulation, socket details, Anim Curves and Animation Notifies panels.
gotchas: Bone manipulations reset when the Animation Editor is closed and reopened

summary: How to build modular characters from multiple skeletal mesh components using Set Leader Pose Component, Copy Pose From Mesh, or runtime Skeletal Mesh Merge, with a cost/feature comparison table, setup steps, and Skeletal Mesh Merge Parameters reference.
gotchas: Leader Pose child meshes must have an exact matching bone subset and cannot animate or simulate physics independently; render cost is not reduced
Copy Pose From Mesh needs the source mesh to tick first or it copies last frame's pose
Merged meshes do not support morph targets and run one animation; plan a common material/texture atlas
Skeletal Merging plugin must be enabled and editor restarted

summary: Basic tutorial on exporting a mesh as FBX from a DCC and importing it as a Static Mesh via the Content Browser, using FBX Import Options and saving the resulting .uasset files.
gotchas: 1 Unreal Unit equals 1 centimeter; check model scale before export
Imported assets are unsaved until Save All

summary: How-to disabling Auto Compute LOD Distances in the Static Mesh Editor and adding per-platform Screen Size overrides (e.g. Mobile) for each LOD.
Hub page for the Proxy Geometry tool set (merging and simplifying meshes for performance), with Starting Out, Guides and Reference sections.
gotchas: Only supported on Windows PCs

summary: Tutorial on adding collision to Static Meshes in the Static Mesh Editor: sphere/capsule/box simplified collision, K-DOP (10/18/26) hulls, Auto Convex Collision with Convex Decomposition settings, composing custom collision from multiple boxes, then enabling Simulate Physics and choosing Collision Presets.
gotchas: Simulate Physics is unavailable on a mesh with no collision
Adding another simplified collision adds to existing shapes instead of replacing them
Collision Presets showing Default means not overridden; another value like BlockAll means overridden
Higher convex decomposition values give more precise but more complex collision

summary: How-to setting per-platform Minimum LOD overrides (Default, Desktop, Console, Mobile) on a Static Mesh to limit which LODs each platform uses and save memory.

How to auto-generate Static Mesh LODs with quadric simplification, either via LOD Group presets defined in [StaticMeshLODSettings] in BaseEngine.ini or manually with Number of LODs and per-LOD Reduction Settings Percent Triangles.
gotchas: Applying a LOD Group overwrites the mesh's current LOD settings
Disabling Auto Compute LOD Distances means screen sizes must be set by hand
Epic recommends LOD Groups over manual LOD setup

summary: Describes deforming Static Meshes with morph targets packed into UV channels and vertex colors by the StaticMeshMorpher.ms 3ds Max script, then applied via the StaticMeshMorphTarget material function into World Position Offset with a Lerp driven by a scalar parameter.
gotchas: Requires 3ds Max to pack morph targets
Morph targets occupy UV channels 2 and 3

summary: Basic guide to assigning materials to a Static Mesh either per placed instance in the level Details panel or as the asset default in the Static Mesh Editor's Material Slots.
gotchas: Material set via the level Details panel affects only that instance, not the Static Mesh asset

summary: Tutorial on creating sockets in the Static Mesh Editor's Socket Manager, positioning them, and attaching/detaching other actors to a socket in the level with Attach To, including resetting the child transform so it snaps.
gotchas: New sockets start at the mesh origin
Attached actor does not snap until its location is reset to default
Transforms on the parent mesh also move attached objects

summary: Explains UV channels for texturing and lightmaps, and how to list, visualize, remove, unwrap (Unwrap UVs) or project (Generate UVs) them in the Static Mesh Editor, plus Blueprint and Python editor scripting to add, insert, remove, unwrap and planar/cylindrical/box project UV channels.
gotchas: Max seven UV channels per Static Mesh; lightmap UVs must be non-overlapping and within 0-1
Cannot delete a UV channel used as lightmap source/destination while Generate Lightmap UVs is on
Projection functions require the target channel to already exist; inserted channels cannot be sparse
Needs Polygon Editing (and UV Editor) plugin and Editor Scripting Utilities; sample code references undefined variables (teapot, box)

summary: How to export assets, the whole level, or selected actors to .gltf or .glb from the editor, with a full reference of glTF Export Options (scale, material baking, proxy materials, LOD, vertex colors, skin weights, animation, textures, lights, cameras, variants).
gotchas: Default Export Uniform Scale 0.01 converts cm to m
Exporting vertex colors usually gives undesirable results (glTF uses them as base color multiplier)
Export Animation Sequences requires Export Vertex Skin Weights; Level Sequences export only transform tracks
KHR_mesh_quantization and KHR_materials_clearcoat may not load in some viewers

summary: How to create glTF proxy materials (pre-baked MI_GLTF material instances) via Create GLTF Proxy Material for previewing, faster exports, and runtime glTF export, and how the reference is stored in Asset User Data.
gotchas: Proxy materials are the only way to export materials properly at runtime
Proxies cannot contain mesh-specific data; create one per mesh for such materials
